sole driver — whole transaction synchronous inside the turn
append-only monotone slots, atomic per-slot writes
sole driver — whole transaction synchronous inside the turn
Scope — one REPL turn redefining a live, compiled, concrete UserFn f (dev session only).
Entry condition — f already has a committed live entry with a populated GOT slot and compiled callers embedding that slot index.

Canonical design — design/int/session-transaction.md (§ refs below), spine design/arch/ownership-inference.md §5, backend interface pinned at design/backend/ownership-codegen.md §8.3 — three calls, all shown here.

Actors follow session-transaction.md §1 (Principle 21). The heap + runtime cadence — closures embedding direct code ptrs, suspended continuations, detached strands — never appears as a lifeline: it is exactly the actor recompilation CANNOT reach, which is why the frozen-world discipline below exists.
new scheme for f — forward call-graph edges recorded on Def.callees (Wave-2 enriched harvest, FIXME 0470)
Pass-1 redef_slots pin: staged slot = prior live slot
AbiSurface = alpha-canonical rendering of the FQ type scheme (§2.2) — increment I adds ONLY the ABI-bearing mode half: param_modes + result (§2.4)
docstring / param-name / body edits are NOT in the comparand
DONE — no reverse index, no closure, no transaction (§2.3).
Late binding preserved verbatim: stale closures and in-flight strands pick up the new body at their next call — L-R2 ABI-preserving leg.

ABI-EPOCH SLOT VERSIONING (§7, spine §5.6, Principle 20) — ABI identity is encoded in slot identity, so a mixed-ABI edge is UNREPRESENTABLE: old callers embed the old slot index, which keeps pointing at old code forever.

NO QUIESCE, NO PATCH WINDOW (§4.3) — between f's commit and each caller's recompile, old caller code chains through frozen slots to old f: a coherent old-ABI world, transitively. Each store_slot is independently atomic. Trampoline, watcher, nice workers never pause.
slotted AbiPreserving and slotted BROKEN callees do NOT propagate.

A slot-less member — constrained template, Overloaded base, callable_got_slot() = None — passes through UNCONDITIONALLY whatever its own outcome (FIXME-0473 ruling): the artifact embedding the changed slot is the mono instance in each CALLER's module, which only the caller's re-typecheck re-mints.
SCC skipped → not re-typechecked, not in the report — L-R3 exactness.
slot-less member breaking = registry record ONLY — no code to retain, no slot to trap-patch.
Its callers are still visited, fail the same instantiation, and break AS THEMSELVES — slotted, so the trap lands at the nearest slotted ancestor instead of vanishing (§4.1 case B).
thereafter /info, /sig, and bare lookup answer BROKEN status + provenance until recovery (§9.2)
recovery is both directions — redefine the broken symbol, or re-redefine f compatibly (§5.3)
[AbiPreserving — body-only edit (the fast path, L-D1 pin §2.3)]

affected closure over reverse edges from f → SCC condensation → reverse-topological order, callees before callers (§4.1)

got().store_slot per member — recompiled caller codegen reads each callee's NEW slot off the committed entry: callee-first ordering makes embedded slot indices land right with no second bookkeeping

got().store_slot(member_slot, trap_ptr) — trap patched IN PLACE: a broken symbol's ABI did not change, so slot identity is kept and breakage does not propagate (§5.1, spine §5.5 at slotted grain)
